title: Unit Event — On the Stage of Dazzling Light — Episode8 That Sparkling Stage

meta.Event: On the Stage of Dazzling Light
meta.Event Outline: Ever since his visit to Riley Dream Park, Tsukasa has felt a desire to improve even more as an actor. In the troupe's new ambassadorial show, he takes on a character unlike any he has before, with a personality entirely opposite his own.

rows.Line: Music Hall

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah, I see... It's usually assigned seating in here, but they made it free seating for their ambassadorial performance. Where would you like to sit, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Wherever works for me.
Still... I wasn't expecting them to be performing somewhere that's a two-hour train ride away.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I apologize for taking time out of your day off, but I really want you to see this show since Tsukasa struggled so much with it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I get that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, I'm just hoping for something a little more serious than the show he did for the School Festival...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, how about these seats?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, this feels like a nice distance away from the stage. Let's sit here.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We made it!
Just in time too...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This place was further than I expected. I guess they really are park ambassadors since they get to perform somewhere like this.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This might be my first time seeing Tsukasa and his troupe perform outside of PXL.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Not only that, Tsukasa was supposed to play the piano today. I'm really looking forward to that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We never really got to hear him play the piano despite how many shows he used to do for us at Saki's house.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh!
That means you all get to see a really cool side of Tsukasa today!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hey, I think it's about to start.

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “We will now be presenting Wonderlands×Showtime's ambassadorial performance of 'A Pianist Named Thorpe'.”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait to see what it's like.

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line:
“*Sigh*
I made it through to the final round of auditions.”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line: “This is it. I might actually pass this time. My usual problems shouldn't get in my way...”

rows.Speaker: Bandleader
rows.Line:
“Alright, next is... Thorpe.
Whenever you're ready.”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line:
“I can do it... I'll be fine.
I just have to play like I practiced...!”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line: “H-Here goes nothing...!”

rows.Speaker: Bandleader
rows.Line:
“Hmm...
How unfortunate...”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line: “Th-Thank you very much...”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line:
“No...!
Why does this keep happening to me...?! At this rate, I'm never going to be able to join a band...!”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Huh...?
I didn't know he could play this kind of character.

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line: “*Sigh*”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line: “The bandleader suggested that I enter into that contest to build my courage, but how can I possibly do well if I keep freezing up when playing for just two or three people...?”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line:
“No, I don't have a choice...
I... I want to keep playing the piano...”

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Tsukasa seems different from usual...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
He really does...
Almost like he's a completely different person...

rows.Speaker: Big Sister Squirrel
rows.Line: “Thank you for playing so beautifully for us, Mr. Pianist! Now, if you'll excuse us!”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line: “They're finally gone. I can practice in peace now... But there might not be any point now since the contest is tomorrow.”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line:
“*Sigh*
I only have half a day left...”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line: “The stars... They're so beautiful...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Thorpe at this point hasn't given up yet...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (He knows he's in a desperate situation, but from the bottom of his heart, he also knows that he doesn't want to stop playing the piano...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (And so, he looks up to the stars...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I'm sorry for ever saying that you lack initiative...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I understand now that you kept persevering. You kept trying despite all odds...)

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line:
“And it's the day of the contest.
Thanks to them, I was hardly able to practice at all...”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line:
“The seats are... Oh, it's a full house.
I'm getting dizzy just thinking about having to play in front of all of them.”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line: “No, I just want to...”

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line:
“Entry number 20!
Thorpe!”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line: “I just want to keep playing.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Thorpe lives to play the piano.
He needs it more than anything else.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (And the most important thing to me is...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, this song...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, not bad.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes...
It's like each note's being wrapped in light.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(They're just like stars...
This must be what Thorpe always saw dotting the sky.)

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line:
“Oh no...!
It's over already...?”

rows.Speaker: Bandleader
rows.Line: “That was magnificent, Thorpe!”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line:
“B-Bandleader!
All I did was play to the best of my abilities...”

rows.Speaker: Bandleader
rows.Line:
“Which is why it was so magnificent.
The old you would've frozen up knowing that you were playing in front of so many people.”

rows.Speaker: Bandleader
rows.Line:
“But look at you now.
Despite playing for a full house, you maintained your focus and played the entire way through.”

rows.Speaker: Bandleader
rows.Line: “How did you practice to get this good? Could it be that you found someone to listen to you play?”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line:
“Oh...!
Some animals visited me and...!”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line: “Wait, uh... Nevermind!”

rows.Speaker: Bandleader
rows.Line: “You sure? Anyway, the audience is calling for an encore. Mind giving us another?”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line: “Yes, of course...!”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line: “Everyone... Including my little friends... Here's my encore.”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line: “Looking back, those animals really seemed to enjoy the way I played the piano. Some danced, some twirled, some slept and some were even cured of what was ailing them...”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line: “That may've been the first time anyone listened so intently to the way I played...”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line: “So, thank you all very much...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Yes, Thorpe, I understand now...
You have your piano and I have my shows.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Let's give everyone who's been there for us some of this light as a small token of our appreciation...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa... He's shining so brightly...
Backstage

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yay!
The crowd's smiling so much!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, I think they really liked it.
This means our next show's a sure thing, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes...
However... All this fatigue is hitting me at once now...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Well done, Tsukasa.
You took a massive step towards making your dreams come true. As your friend and director, I couldn't be happier.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I appreciate it...!
And it's all thanks to you and everyone, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me.
We should go say hi to Saki and everyone!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right!!
I'll join you!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I really had my doubts, but he pulled through for us in the end...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, he did.
That's our troupe leader for you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, let's wait for them here!
Hm...?

rows.Speaker: Elderly Woman
rows.Line: Excuse me... Didn't you play the protagonist today? Are you free right now?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, I am!
How can I help you?

rows.Speaker: Elderly Woman
rows.Line: I actually live just nearby and decided to stop by for today's show.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Woman
rows.Line:
You did such a wonderful job.
It was as if the stage sparkled with light.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Woman
rows.Line: I'll be rooting for you, so keep it up.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Thank you very much...!
I really appreciate it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I don't know what to say...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (This performance only became possible after asking for everyone's help, and I'm the one being praised.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Plus, I was able to tap the memories from when I was little, including the pain and sadness I felt, in order to play this role. I couldn't be happier...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (And to keep growing as an actor, I want to keep experiencing more and more new things.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alrighty then...!!
I vow to keep learning as much as I can and become a true star!!

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line: Hey, that voice... It's Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, that must be Saki I'm hearing...!
Saki!!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Up, up, up we go...!
Oh, Tsukasa's talking with his friends!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Be careful, Miku.
What if someone sees you peeking out of his phone?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <No, I wanna congratulate Tsukasa too!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Hehe. I understand how you feel, but that may have to wait until later...>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line:
Thank you for coming!!
Allow me to show you my appreciation as a future star!!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Hehe...!!
Good for you, Tsukasa☆>
